notes: Where an upload stands, for a client that comes back after a break: done_parts are the parts the bucket has with their size; send the others (with links from /parts), then complete. state is receiving, finishing (being finished right now) or complete; a finished upload lists every part as done, so a client whose complete answer got lost learns it is done. 404 not_found: start the file again (the upload isn't the caller's, was cancelled, or the bucket dropped it). 503 s3_unavailable with Retry-After while the bucket can't be asked.
